$comment: Generated from the Tako CLI's tako.toml parser types. Do not edit by hand.

storage.description: Private S3-compatible storage resource used for app data backups.

cwd.description: Working directory for build commands, relative to the project root.

exclude.description: File globs to exclude from the deploy artifact.

include.description: Additional file globs to include in the deploy artifact.

cwd.description:
Optional working directory relative to tako.toml location.
Allows ".." for monorepo traversal (guarded against escaping workspace root).

exclude.description: File globs to exclude from the deploy artifact.

ComposeConfig.description: One Compose project on one server, with one HTTP service exposed by Tako.

file.description: Compose file, relative to the app directory and inside it.

health_host.description: HTTP Host header sent with health checks.

port.description: Port the service listens on inside its container.

service.description: Compose service that receives HTTP traffic.

command.description: Arguments that replace the image command.

data_dir.description: The app's persistent data directory inside the container.

entrypoint.description: Program that replaces the image entrypoint.

health_host.description: HTTP Host header sent with health checks. Only for plain images (`sdk = false`).

port.description: Port the app listens on inside the container.

sdk.description: Use the Tako SDK bootstrap and authenticated health contract.

secret_env.description: Explicit secret names to deliver as environment variables for plain images.

user.description:
Map this container identity to the service user's host identity.
Useful for images whose USER is non-root, without chowning shared data.

EnvConfig.description: Deploy environment from `[envs.<name>]`. Use either `route` or `routes`, not both. Put environment variables in `[vars.<name>]`.

backup.description: Autopilot backup target for this environment.

network.description:
Native network, identified by its stable 32-character hexadecimal ID
(see `tako network list`). Local aliases are not portable project configuration.

release.description:
Per-environment release command override. An empty string explicitly
clears the top-level `release` command for this environment.

route.description:
Route: an exact host, wildcard host, or either with a path, such as
`app.example.com`, `*.example.com`, or `example.com/api/*`.
Mutually exclusive with `routes`.

servers.description: Deployment targets. In a native network these are enrolled names or device IDs.

source_ip.description: Client source-IP mode for requests to this environment.

ssl.description: Certificate provider for public route HTTPS.

storages.description:
Storage bindings assigned to this environment.

Key = app binding name exposed as `tako.storages.<key>`.
Value = backing storage resource name from `[storages.<value>]`, or
the built-in `local` resource.

local_patterns.description: Local image path patterns, such as `/images/**`. Defaults to `["/**"]`.

remote_patterns.description: Remote image URL patterns. Remote images are denied unless they match.

ServerWorkflows.description: Per-server workflow overrides. Other keys are named worker groups. `retention` belongs in the app's `[workflows]` section.

concurrency.description: Max parallel task slots per worker. Parsed, but does not yet control production supervision.

workers.description: Number of always-on worker processes. `0` means scale-to-zero. Parsed, but does not yet control production supervision.

StorageResourceConfig.description:
S3-compatible storage resource from [storages.*]. Credentials are stored
encrypted in `.tako/secrets.json`, not here.

force_path_style.description: Use path-style bucket URLs instead of virtual-hosted bucket URLs.

provider.description: Storage provider. Only `s3` can be declared; `local` is built in.

public_base_url.description: Public HTTPS base URL for objects. Backup storage must not set it.

VarValue.description: Converted to a process-env string. TOML datetimes are also accepted.

concurrency.description: Max parallel task slots per worker.

run.description:
Command that runs this workflow worker group, for runtimes that need
one. Container releases translate it to an entrypoint override, while
native releases run it directly.

workers.description: Number of always-on worker processes. `0` means scale-to-zero.

Workflows.description: Workflow settings. Other keys are named worker groups, selected by `worker: "name"` in workflow definitions.

concurrency.description: Max parallel task slots per worker. Parsed, but does not yet control production supervision.

retention.description: When finished workflow runs and their saved steps become eligible for cleanup: a positive whole number followed by `s`, `m`, `h`, or `d`, such as `"30d"`, or `"forever"`. Defaults to `"184d"`.

workers.description: Number of always-on worker processes. `0` means scale-to-zero. Parsed, but does not yet control production supervision.

description: Tako app configuration. Reference: https://tako.sh/docs/tako-toml. This schema can be looser than the CLI's validation; `tako` remains the authority.

app_root.description: JS channels, presence, stores, and workflows root, relative to `tako.toml`. Defaults to `src`; use `.` for root-level files.

assets.description: Additional asset directories merged into deployed `public/`, relative to the project root.

build.description: Simple build. Cannot be combined with `[[build_stages]]` when `run`, `include`, or `exclude` is set.

build_stages.description: Multi-stage build, run in order. Mutually exclusive with `[build].run`.

compose.description: Docker Compose release: one Compose project on one server, with one HTTP service exposed by Tako.

container.description: Container file path for container releases, relative to `tako.toml`. `container`, `image`, and `[compose]` are mutually exclusive.

dev.description: Custom `tako dev` command, such as `["vite", "dev"]`. Overrides preset and runtime defaults unless a CLI command is passed.

envs.description: Environments. Deploy environments must define `route` or `routes`. `development` is reserved for `tako dev`.

development.description: Local development with `tako dev`. Routes are optional and default to `<name>.test`.

image.description: Prebuilt container image reference, such as `registry/name:tag`. `container`, `image`, and `[compose]` are mutually exclusive.

images.description: Public image optimizer allowlists. Each array replaces its default and must be non-empty.

main.description: Runtime entrypoint override. May be a file path or module specifier.

name.description: Stable app identity. Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens; starts with a lowercase letter, ends with a letter or number, at most 63 characters. If omitted, Tako derives the name from the config file's directory. Renaming creates a separate deployed app.

package_manager.description: JS package manager override: `bun`, `npm`, `pnpm`, or `yarn`. Detected from `package.json` or lockfiles when omitted.

preset.description: Runtime-local preset alias such as `vite`, `tanstack-start`, or `nextjs`. Provides `main` and `assets` defaults.

release.description: One-shot command run on the leader server before the rolling update, such as `bun run db:migrate`. Can be overridden per environment.

runtime.description: Runtime adapter, optionally pinned with `@version`, such as `bun@1.2.3`, `node`, or `go`.

schemas.description: External `tako-schema.json` files or HTTP(S) URLs. File paths are relative to `tako.toml`. `tako gen` compiles them into native types.

servers.description: Per-server overrides from `[servers.<server>]`. Server names follow the app-name rules.

start.description: Native deploy start command for prebuilt artifacts. An exact `{main}` argument is replaced with the resolved entrypoint.

storages.description: S3-compatible storage resources, bound to environments with `[envs.<env>].storages`. `local` is built in and cannot be declared.

anyOf.description: Variables for one environment, merged on top of `[vars]`.

vars.description: Environment variables for every environment. A nested table `[vars.<env>]` overrides them for one environment.

title: tako.toml
